exposure: Caesarean section via Traditional Pfannenstiel incision
Caesarean section via Misgav Ladach method
outcome: Satisfaction with cosmetic appearance of scar
cohort: Patients who underwent either the 'Traditional' caesarean section method using Pfannenstiel incision or the 'Misgav Ladach' caesarean section method.
finding: The Misgav Ladach method resulted in statistically better long-term postoperative outcomes, including lower pain intensity, reduced neuropathic and chronic pain, and higher satisfaction with the cosmetic appearance of the scar, compared to the Traditional method.
mod_finding: The Misgav Ladach caesarean section technique yielded better long-term results regarding pain intensity, neuropathic and chronic pain presence, and cosmetic scar satisfaction compared to the Traditional Pfannenstiel method.
